svg.title: Speed by mode and script length
svg.desc: Bar chart: warm real-time factor of the Vocello 3.2 models by script length, lower is faster: Built-in Voice 0.29 to 0.36, Voice Design 0.29 to 0.34, Voice Cloning 0.29 to 0.38. Every bar sits below the real-time line at 1.0.
